title: Trading and settlement of trades in dematerialised securities
text: Trading and settlement of trades in dematerialised securities Apr 25, 2000| Circulars SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE BOARD OF INDIA SECONDARY MARKET DEPARTMENT Mittal Court, A Wing, Gr. Floor, 224, Nariman Point, Mumbai 400 021 SMDRP/Policy/Cir-17/2000 April 25, 2000 To, The President/Executive Directors/ Managing Director of the Stock Exchanges/ NSDL/CDSL/Custodians and AMFI/RAIN Dear Sir, Trading and settlement of trades in dematerialised securities Please refer to our earlier circular no. SMDRP/Policy/Cir-9/2000 dated February 16, 2000 on the subject advising inter alia the list of scrips for compulsory settlement of trades in dematerialised form for all investors. 1. It has been decided to include the under mentioned companies in the list of securities for compulsory settlement of trades in dematerialised form for all investors effective from June 26, 2000. Man Industries (I) Limited KPIT Systems Limited BLB Limited 2. The under mentioned companies, which were earlier scheduled to be compulsorily traded and settled in dematerialised form for all investors effective from June 26, 2000, shall now be compulsorily traded and settled in dematerialised form for all investors effective from May 8, 2000. Polaris software Limited Siltap Chemicals Limited Yours faithfully, P. K. BINDLISH DIVISION CHIEF SECONDARY MARKET, DEPOSITORY, RESEARCH & PUBLICATIONS DEPARTMENT E-Mail: pkb@sebi.gov.in Phone no.: 022-2843631
